title: Albert Wynn, Jasper Taylor and Dave Payton
summary: Chicago trombonists and the pianist and arranger Dave Payton.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: There's one other New Orleans tromboneist here, Albert Wynn. Do you know that?
Yeah, he took a couple of lessons. He didn't stay, but he took enough to learn to play pretty good. He plays pretty good.

What's one of them? He's around. He, uh, up in our place where a friend, we have a piano, sort of a studio, not a real big recording studio, but some bands used to come up and rehearse. And about a year ago, he was there with a few people. Oh, yeah? I can't remember who, oh, Jasper Taylor. Yeah, Jasper Taylor, yeah. He was with him. He was with him.

And, uh, Albert Wynn played pretty nice, I thought. Yeah. Nice, uh. He doesn't work much. Like I said, there aren't many bands here Chicago that do use a trombone unless they... No, there is a trombone. Oh, no. Just about to. I think we'd better quit. Dave Payton, yes, I heard that Dave Payton died. I knew him. I never heard him play much, but I talked to him a couple of times. He was a good pianist. Nice piano.
